title: Marina Power Cost per Weekend Stay
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marina:power marina_name=* weekend_cost_usd=*
| stats avg(weekend_cost_usd) as avg_weekend_cost_usd, count as events by marina_name
| sort - avg_weekend_cost_usd
description: Shows average weekend power cost by marina for weekend marina stays.
value: Average weekend power cost by marina helps compare weekend marina stays across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `weekend_cost_usd` on `marina:power` events and normalize `marina_name` so Splunk can summarize performance by marina.
visualization: Bar chart of average weekend power cost by marina.
grandmaExplanation: It frames the average weekend power cost for each marina so you can see what works best for weekend marina stays.
